name: Gambian Domoda

name: Gambian Benachin
description: Benachin, meaning 'one pot', tomato-and-pepper rice cooked with meat and vegetables, is a genuine Gambian original and a direct ancestor of the wider West African jollof tradition.
steps_detailed: Brown the chicken, 6-7 minutes, then set aside.

name: Gambian Yassa
description: Yassa, chicken marinated and cooked in a mountain of caramelized onions and lemon, is beloved across the Gambia as it is throughout the wider Senegambian region.
steps_detailed: Marinate the chicken in the lemon juice and garlic for at least 20 minutes.
Brown the chicken, 6-7 minutes, then set aside.
Cook the onion over medium-low heat, stirring often, 20-25 minutes, until deeply softened and sweet.
Return the chicken with a splash of water and simmer 15 minutes more.
